_opportunity_about: Which business line this front door sells. It rides on every Join link as ?o=&s= so the back office records which site a partner came in through, and it decides whether a card is asked for — see backend/config/opportunities.php. Set to plasmaguard on 2026-09-22 when the site became product-first: somebody joining from here is joining to sell air purification systems, which is free, and the training program is an add-on they buy later from inside the back office.

_storefront_about: Where an order is actually placed. A partner's replicated site (q3.life/CODE) turns its Order buttons into {app}/p/CODE/plasmaguard/pro-in-duct — the partner-coded storefront in the back office, which takes the address, computes PlasmaGuard's tax and charges their Stripe account. The vendor and product keys must match backend/config/vendors.php. A visitor with no code has no partner to order through, so they get the contact form instead.

storefront.price_note: Shipping, handling and any sales tax are added at checkout, where PlasmaGuard calculates them from the delivery address.
